name: employment-labor-law-eu
description: Structured knowledge graph for EU employment and labour law. Covers the Working Time Directive (2003/88/EC), Equal Treatment Directives (2006/54/EC, 2000/43/EC, 2000/78/EC), Temporary Agency Workers Directive (2008/104/EC), Transfer of Undertakings / TUPE (2001/23/EC), Collective Redundancies Directive (98/59/EC), Posted Workers Directive (96/71/EC, revised 2018/957), Transparent & Predictable Working Conditions Directive (2019/1152), Work-Life Balance Directive (2019/1158), European Works Councils Directive (2009/38/EC), Platform Workers Directive (2024/2831), and key concepts including employment contracts, termination, anti-discrimination, collective bargaining, and industrial action.
author: ANTON Legal Team
